title: To my favorite person,
paragraphs: I made this little thing for you because I wanted to give you something you could come back to whenever you needed a little smile.

I know I don't say it a lot, but I really admire you. I love how smart and hardworking you are, how much you care about the things that matter to you, and especially how soft you are when it comes to animals.

And somehow I still think about our first date how cute you were, the way you talked, and all the little things about you I noticed that day. The more I get to know you, the more things I find myself liking about you.
I know I can be a bad texter sometimes, so I’m sorry if I don't always show it properly. But I hope this little corner of the internet can remind you that you're thought of and appreciated.
I hope it makes you smile :)
